title: RBI Shortens CRR & SLR Exemption Deadline to August 31, 2026
content:
# RBI Shortens CRR & SLR Exemption Deadline to August 31, 2026

Ek important update hai! Reserve Bank of India (RBI) ne recently specified FCNR(B) aur NRE term deposits par milne waali CRR aur SLR exemption ki deadline revise ki hai.

Here are the key details:

*   **What:** The RBI has reduced the eligibility period for exemption from Cash Reserve Ratio (CRR) and Statutory Liquidity Ratio (SLR) requirements for fresh FCNR(B) and NRE term deposits. This applies to various banking categories including Commercial Banks, Small Finance Banks, Regional Rural Banks, Urban Co-operative Banks, and Rural Co-operative Banks.
*   **Old Due Date:** The exemption was previously available for deposits mobilized until September 30, 2026.
*   **New Due Date:** The new cut-off date for mobilizing eligible deposits is now **August 31, 2026**.
*   **Effective Date:** This change has come into force with immediate effect from August 25, 2026.
*   **Applicability:** This amendment covers fresh FCNR(B) deposits with a minimum tenor of three years and a maximum tenor of five years, and fresh Non-Resident (External) Rupee (NRE) term deposits of three years or more. These also include deposits that are renewed upon maturity.
*   **Notification Details:** The RBI has issued "Fourth Amendment Directions, 2026" for different bank categories. For instance, the notification for Small Finance Banks is RBI/2026-27/239, DOR.RET.REC.206/12.01.001/2026-27, dated August 25, 2026.
